claims.description: Only current-session validated non-owner authority remains usable during background refetch; cold, unvalidated, owner/family, explicit-proxy, and missing-selection states remain loading-gated.
Deferred-refetch provider tests keep owner/proxy-capable cached authority behind loading while pending and preserve hard-error handling after failure or changed binding.

The resolver and provider matrix covers cold start, learner mount, owner with charge, joined learner, repeated foreground refresh, success/failure, and authority transitions, and fails under the deliberate global-loading mutant.
Repeated AppState-active refreshes retain the intended call cadence, while layout regressions prove no shell, redirect, create-profile, or consent gate flash.
Full affected profile and layout suites, mobile typecheck, targeted lint, formatting, and whitespace validation are green; the PR supplies the authoritative full change-class gate.
